panels.title: Memory pressure
panels.description: Pressure level of each manager and data node: green normal, yellow warn (caches shrink), red shed (puts refused). Anything not green for long needs attention.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_memory_pressure_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "manager" + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_mem_pressure_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "data" + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: RSS per node
panels.description: Latest resident memory of each manager and data node. Compare with the cap and thresholds in the Memory section; the percent-of-budget ratio needs a join across measurements that InfluxQL cannot express.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_memory_rss_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "manager" + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_mem_rss_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "data" + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Dropped batches
panels.description: Metrics batches dropped from a full push queue over the selected range, all nodes and servers. 0 is normal; any drop means points were lost, see the Metrics pipeline section.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_metrics_dropped_batches" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: "dropped"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Proxy rejected
panels.description: PushMetrics batches a manager refused over the selected range (auth, no servers, bad encoding, too large, bad line). 0 is normal; any rejection means proxy-mode nodes are losing metrics.

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "dc", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/, start: -1d)

list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "role", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/ and contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}), start: -1d)
